title: A Change of Plan
gist_ar: إيميل بيغيّر معاد اجتماع ويوضّح الجدول الجديد.
text:
Dear team,

I am writing to change the arrangements for next week. We were going to hold the meeting on Tuesday, but two colleagues are travelling that day, so I have decided to postpone it.

The new schedule is: the meeting is taking place on Thursday at ten o'clock in Room 4. It will last ninety minutes. I am going to send the documents on Wednesday morning, so please read them before you arrive.

If you cannot come on Thursday, tell me before Monday and I will arrange a short call instead. I expect that we will finish the main decisions in one meeting, but if we need more time, we will organise a second meeting in two weeks.

Please note the deadline for the report has not changed: it is still the end of the month. I promise I will not cancel anything again!

Best wishes,
Hanan

questions.q: When is the meeting taking place now?
What should you do if you cannot come?
questions.q_ar: لو مش هتقدر تيجي تعمل إيه؟
